rules.cwe_name: Improper Access Control
rules.description: An access-control policy is missing or incorrectly enforced for a protected resource.

rules.cwe_name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
rules.description: Downloading executables and other sensitive files over an insecure connection opens up for potential man-in-the-middle attacks.

rules.cwe_name: Use of Cryptographically Weak Pseudo-Random Number Generator (PRNG)
rules.description: Using a cryptographically weak pseudo-random number generator to generate a security-sensitive value may allow an attacker to predict what value will be generated.

rules.cwe_name: Generation of Predictable Numbers or Identifiers
rules.description: Tokens used for sensitive tasks, such as, password recovery, and email confirmation, should not use predictable values.

rules.cwe_name: Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition
rules.description: Separately checking the state of a file before operating on it may allow an attacker to modify the file between the two operations.

rules.cwe_name: Use of Potentially Dangerous Function
rules.description: DOM functions that act like 'eval' and execute strings as code are dangerous and impede program analysis and understanding. Consequently, they should not be used.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
rules.description: Escaping code as HTML does not provide protection against code injection.

rules.cwe_name: Numeric Truncation Error
rules.description: The integer shift operators '<<', '>>' and '>>>' only take the five least significant bits of their right operand into account. Thus, it is not possible to shift an integer by more than 31 bits.

rules.cwe_name: Reliance on Undefined, Unspecified, or Implementation-Defined Behavior
rules.description: Conditional comments are an IE-specific feature and not portable.

rules.cwe_name: Incorrect Block Delimitation
rules.description: The body of a control statement should have appropriate indentation to clarify which statements it controls and which ones it does not control.
